entities.summary: Irma Boom is a Dutch graphic designer who specializes in bookmaking. Boom has been described as the "Queen of Books," having created over 300 books and is well reputed for her artistic autonomy within her field. Her bold experimental approach to her projects often challenges the convention of traditional books in both physical design and printed content. Irma Boom was a architects & designers from Lochem (b. 1960-12-15, Lochem).
